steps.description:
Show that your robot can perform the following:
1. Move forward at a speed of 100 for 2 seconds.

Hint:
1. Both Left and Right wheels must have the same speed.
2. Both Left and Right wheels must be positive.

Show that your robot can perform the following:
1. Move forward at a speed of 100 for 2 seconds.

2. Move backwards at a speed of 100 for 2 seconds.


Hint:
1. Both Left and Right wheels must have the same speed.
2. Move forward - Both Left and Right wheels must be positive.
3. Move backwards - Both Left and Right wheels must be negative.
